items.title: Accept or decline the daycare place for Jonas
items.quote: Bitte sagen Sie uns binnen 12 Arbeitstagen ab dem Datum dieses Briefes zu oder ab.
items.computation: The letter's own date is Thursday 19.11.2026, and the period is expressly tied to 'dem Datum dieses Briefes' (a specific calendar date), not to an event such as delivery/notification. Under § 187 Abs. 2 BGB, when a period's start is fixed by naming the day itself, that day counts as day 1 (unlike § 187 Abs. 1, which would apply to an event-triggered period and exclude the first day). The letter further specifies that only Monday-Friday are counted and public holidays are disregarded ('Gezählt werden Montag bis Freitag; Feiertage bleiben außer Betracht'). Counting 12 business days from 19.11.2026 (NRW has no public holidays in this window): Day1 Thu 19.11, Day2 Fri 20.11, (weekend 21-22 skipped), Day3 Mon 23.11, Day4 Tue 24.11, Day5 Wed 25.11, Day6 Thu 26.11, Day7 Fri 27.11, (weekend 28-29 skipped), Day8 Mon 30.11, Day9 Tue 01.12, Day10 Wed 02.12, Day11 Thu 03.12, Day12 Fri 04.12.2026. No NRW public holiday falls in this range, and the 12th day (Friday) is not a weekend/holiday, so no shift is needed. Due date: 04.12.2026. Note: if instead the event/notification rule of § 187 Abs. 1 BGB were applied (excluding 19.11. and starting the count on 20.11.), the deadline would instead fall on 07.12.2026 — see warning.

warnings: The deadline-counting rule is ambiguous: the letter ties the 12-Arbeitstage period to 'dem Datum dieses Briefes' (19.11.2026, a Thursday). I applied § 187 Abs. 2 BGB (period start fixed by a named calendar date, so that day counts as day 1), giving 04.12.2026 as the deadline. If the provider instead intends an event-based start under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (excluding 19.11. and starting the count the next day), the deadline would be 07.12.2026 instead. To be safe, respond no later than 04.12.2026.
No legal-remedy instructions (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) are present, which is normal for this type of private offer letter rather than an administrative decision.
